
# **Bioinformants: Installation and execution**


This is a Java based NetBeans Project developed to process data from Ensembl and get positive and negative examples about different structural sites in genes (TSS, TTS, GT splicing site, AG splicing site, and so on).

To run the project do the following:

1. Set an enviroment variable named WORKSPACE in this way:

set WORKSPACE=YOUR-HOME-DIRECTORY/datos_ensembl/

2. Copy the datos_ensembl folder in the project's tree to your home directory

3. Execute the command java -jar bioinformants.jar <bp upstream> <mRNA|CDS> as described below

java -jar bioinformants.jar predictor.Data 1000 mRNA

or

java -jar bioinformants.jar predictor.Data 100 CDS

4. The datos_ensembl folder will include some new diectories and files, like 3-187668812-187670494.txt below
with an example register of the kind of data used later on to train machine learning models.

([ENSG00000157005.4], % Ensembl Gen ID.

[1000], % Gen start coordenate referenced from zero.

[2482], % Gen end coordenate referenced from zero.

[], % DNA sequence from Ensembl

[3], % Chromosome the gen ENSG00000157005.4 belongs to.

[187667913], % Gen start coordenate referenced to Ensembl coordinates

[187671395], % Gen end coordenate referenced to Ensembl coordinates
false) % Watson strand?. In this case false meaning the gen is on Crick strand.

([1000,1240],[2117,2482],[1]) % Corrdinates of the exons in the DNA sequence (referenced to zero)
